scope: Existing native mechanism and observation candidates; not llama.cpp patches or enabled CC integrations.

components.hypothesis: A bounded change in resident expert budget can reduce demand stalls without starving unified host memory.
components.bounds: One reserve setting only; keep vram-experts fixed; never reduce tested headroom without separate admission.
components.source_mapping: Inspect matching source revision before implementation; symbol/flag references are not automatic applicability evidence.

components.hypothesis: Adaptive placement may exchange CPU/storage work for promotion work.
components.bounds: One enabled/disabled cache toggle; preserve all six experts; no scoring if outputs fail the frozen policy.
components.source_mapping: Inspect matching source revision before implementation; symbol/flag references are not automatic applicability evidence.

components.hypothesis: A different CPU worker budget may reduce oversubscription or improve overlap.
components.bounds: Compare 4 versus 8 threads under the same 8-CPU quota; do not change async threads simultaneously.
components.source_mapping: Inspect matching source revision before implementation; symbol/flag references are not automatic applicability evidence.

components.hypothesis: Prefill chunk size can alter launch overhead and memory pressure.
components.bounds: One chunk-size change; generation settings and cache policy remain fixed; start at the tested 256 setting.
components.source_mapping: Inspect matching source revision before implementation; symbol/flag references are not automatic applicability evidence.

components.hypothesis: Verified draft tokens can save target steps if draft cost is repaid.
components.bounds: Test none versus on as a separate admitted workload; do not tune confidence in the same comparison; auto can unload the drafter.
components.source_mapping: Inspect matching source revision before implementation; symbol/flag references are not automatic applicability evidence.

components.hypothesis: Readiness-at-demand instrumentation can show whether speculative reads complete in time to help.
components.bounds: Observability only first; no runtime prefetch change; traces do not score.
components.source_mapping: Inspect matching source revision before implementation; symbol/flag references are not automatic applicability evidence.

components.hypothesis: Phase and resource telemetry can separate decode, prefill, physical reads and collector overhead.
components.bounds: No engine semantics change; useful signal and bounded observer cost required; no claimed speedup.
components.source_mapping: Inspect matching source revision before implementation; symbol/flag references are not automatic applicability evidence.

promotion: Requires source mapping, applicability, bounded effects, correctness, negative replay, observer/performance evidence and operator authority.
